item.title: Building a Threat Hunting Lab with Elastic Stack
item.description: A detection lab should answer one question quickly: can I observe the behavior I care about, and can I turn that observation into a useful analytic? The lab does not need to be large, but it does need to be repeatable. I like Elastic for this kind of work because it gives me ingestion, search, dashboards, and detection rules in one place without hiding the raw event details.
